page.overview:
Who is Falra?

{|cellspacing="1" cellpadding="3" border="0" align="center"

Pages for this subject as it appears in other canons:

Falra (d. 10180 AG) was a Fremen of Sietch Tabr.

She was was raised with Imperial Liet-Kynes and later married him in 10176 AG. The wedding was officiated by Kynes' brother Stilgar ben Fifrawi.
